data.long_meaning: Sunit is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning sun. The name Sunit is a symbol of brilliance, power, and intelligence. It is believed that the bearer of this name will radiate with the energy and power of the sun. The name Sunit carries the meaning “Sun, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sunit usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
